entities.summary: Mehmed II, a notable figure in the history of Bosnia and Herzegovina, associated with Ottoman Conquest and Early Ottoman Bosnia (1463–1482). Preceded by Bosnian Kingdom and Ottoman conquest of Bosnia; last Bosnian King Stefan Tomašević executed. Their legacy influenced Islamization and Ottoman Urban Culture.
